DT_Stack.name: The Stack
DT_Stack.text: Vast near-future city where radically different kinds of people share the same society but do not experience it equally. Social differences in wealth, status, access, legal standing, bodily autonomy, cultural belonging and personhood shape daily life. Physical verticality gives the city scale and visual variety but does not define its social structure. Visual inspiration leans strongest toward Altered Carbon: sophisticated, dense, glamorous, dangerous and unequal, with additional clarity of class and power drawn from Snowpiercer and The Hunger Games. The city is a mixed society rather than a set of neat caste zones; privilege and exclusion cut across Baselines, Organics, Augments and Intelligences in different ways.

DT_OrganicDistricts.name: Organic Districts
DT_OrganicDistricts.text: Neighborhoods where Organics live, work, repair, socialize and build community. Treat them as lived social environments with their own aesthetics, status, relationships and internal variety—not as machinery zones or industrial warrens.

DT_GovernanceUpperLevels.name: Governance Upper Levels
DT_GovernanceUpperLevels.text: Controlled civic and corporate upper levels with cleaner architecture, access barriers, surveillance and procedural order. Emphasize social privilege, institutional power, ease and exclusion more than literal engineering or technical systems.
